items.title: LTP – Lazy Tool Protocol. Up to 93% token reduction for AI agents
items.raw_excerpt: Hi HN, I’m the creator of LTP (Lazy Tool Protocol). I built this because I was frustrated with the hidden costs of building AI agents with many tools. The current standard for tool-calling (like MCP) often requires loading every tool's full JSON schema into the AI's context at the start of a session. If you have dozens or hundreds of tools, you’re burning through tens of thousands of tokens before the agent even says "Hello." LTP changes this by introducing a "Lazy Loading" pattern. Instead of bloating the context, LTP uses a CLI-based bridge. The AI agent only fetches the specific tool definitions it needs, when it needs them. For a long time, climate, weather, and Earth system research have relied almost entirely on numerical simulations. Supercomputers are tasked with solving physical equations layer by layer, where the precision, resolution, and stability of the models determine how much of the natural system humans can "see clearly." In recent years, with changes in computing power, artificial intelligence has increasingly been introduced into these traditional fields. Particularly in climate and Earth system modeling, AI is held with high expectations: can it fill in the details that numerical models struggle to cover? Can it provide a finer view of the system under limited computing power? These questions are becoming unavoidable discussions in the fields of supercomputing and scientific computing.

Earth system models represent one of the most typical scenarios in this regard. From global circulation to local weather, from oceans to the atmosphere, and from kilometer-scale to finer variations, the processes these models need to handle are extremely complex and nearly impossible to fully exhaust. Precisely because of this, academia and engineering circles have maintained a cautious, even divided, attitude toward how AI should be integrated into Earth system modeling.

excerpt_i18n.en: Cloud providers are now at a critical juncture to break through. On December 23, the globally authoritative AI benchmark platform Artificial Analysis released its latest image model rankings. Alibaba's 6B-parameter Z-Image Turbo surpassed the 32B FLUX.2 to become the top open-source image generation model. Currently, the model is available on Alibaba Cloud's Bailian platform, costing only $5 to generate 1,000 images.

Z-Image Turbo overtook FLUX.2 to top the Artificial Analysis image model rankings. According to official data from Artificial Analysis, Z-Image Turbo achieved an ELO score of 1152, setting a new record on the leaderboard. Industry experts consider it one of the best-performing, fastest-generating, and most affordable image generation models available.

Z-Image Turbo supports deployment on consumer-grade graphics cards with 16GB of VRAM. In an H100 deployment environment, it takes only one second to generate images comparable to those produced by models with tens of billions of parameters. In terms of output quality, the model significantly enhances image realism, finely restoring details such as skin texture, hair strands, and fabric materials. It also improves bilingual text rendering capabilities in Chinese and English, maintaining clear text and natural layouts even in challenging scenarios like small fonts, complex typography, or poster designs.

Z-Image Turbo is capable of generating hyper-realistic images and bilingual Chinese-English posters.

"The key to the commercial loop in the computing power industry lies in shifting from helping clients save money to helping them earn money. items.title: 腾讯云Valkey社区贡献位居全球第一，率先在国内支持8.0版本
items.raw_excerpt: 随着新一代开源内存数据库 Valkey 在全球社区加速成熟，开源基础软件格局正迎来重要变化。12 月 23 日，腾讯云宣布国内率先支持并发布 Valkey 8.0 版本，同时以社区代码贡献量位居全球第一，成为推动该项目走向生产级应用的重要力量。 Valkey 是由 Linux 基金会托管、源自 Redis 社区的开源内存 Key-Value 数据库项目，致力于以宽松开源协议和社区共治模式，构建厂商中立、长期稳定的基础软件平台。 Valkey 开源负责人 Kyle Davis 表示，Valkey 重新找回了开源社区的初心，腾讯云等云厂商的持续投入，为项目的长期可持续发展奠定了坚实基础。 目前，AWS、Google Cloud、甲骨文、腾讯云、阿里云、华为云等全球头部云厂商已深度参与 Valkey 社区共建，形成以社区为核心的开源协作格局，Valkey 中国社区也已在北京成立，中国开发者正深度参与全球社区治理。 作为 Valkey 社区创始成员之一，腾讯云深度参与项目共建，将云上大规模业务实践持续回馈社区，在集群扩缩容、性能优化和稳定性增强等方向贡献了大量核心代码。 腾讯云数据库专家朱彬彬（Binbin Zhu）近两年在 Redis 与 Valkey 社区累计贡献 360多 个 PR，贡献量位居全球第一，并担任社区技术指导委员会（TSC）和 Core Team 成员，直接参与项目技术路线和版本演进。 (图：Valkey Github代码仓库，Valkey 由 Redis 社区演进而来，统计含 Redis/Valkey 社区贡献) 此次发布的 Valkey 8.0 是 Valkey 项目从 Redis 分叉后发布的首个重要大版本，在继承 Redis 7.2.4 能力基础上，由社区独立演进，在性能和资源效率方面实现显著提升，并进一步面向 Search 与 AI 场景演进，增强对新一

excerpt_i18n.en: With the new generation open-source in-memory database Valkey rapidly maturing in the global community, the landscape of open-source foundational software is undergoing significant changes. On December 23, Tencent Cloud announced it was the first in China to support and release Valkey 8.0, while also ranking first globally in community code contributions, becoming a key force driving the project toward production-level applications. Valkey is an open-source in-memory key-value database project hosted by the Linux Foundation and originating from the Redis community, dedicated to building a vendor-neutral, long-term stable foundational software platform through permissive open-source licensing and community governance. Kyle Davis, the open-source lead for Valkey, stated that Valkey has rediscovered the original intent of the open-source community, and the continuous investment from cloud providers like Tencent Cloud has laid a solid foundation for the project's long-term sustainable development. Currently, leading global cloud providers such as AWS, Google Cloud, Oracle, Tencent Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, and Huawei Cloud are deeply involved in the Valkey community, forming an open-source collaboration model centered around the community. The Valkey China community has also been established in Beijing, with Chinese developers actively participating in global community governance. As one of the founding members of the Valkey community, Tencent Cloud is deeply involved in the project's development, continuously feeding back large-scale cloud business practices to the community and contributing significant core code in areas such as cluster scaling, performance optimization, and stability enhancement. Tencent Cloud database expert Zhu Binbin.
excerpt_i18n.es: A medida que la nueva generación de base de datos en memoria de código abierto Valkey madura rápidamente en la comunidad global, el panorama del software básico de código abierto está experimentando cambios significativos. El 23 de diciembre, Tencent Cloud anunció que fue el primero en China en ofrecer soporte y lanzar la versión 8.0 de Valkey, al tiempo que se posicionó como líder mundial en contribuciones de código a la comunidad, convirtiéndose en una fuerza clave para impulsar el proyecto hacia aplicaciones de nivel productivo. Valkey es un proyecto de base de datos en memoria clave-valor de código abierto, alojado por la Linux Foundation y originado en la comunidad Redis, que se dedica a construir una plataforma de software básico neutral para proveedores, estable y a largo plazo, mediante un protocolo de código abierto permisivo y un modelo de gobernanza comunitaria.
